resources.string: Answer by opening the phone, end calls by closing it
Answer an incoming call by opening the phone
Closing the phone ends or declines the call. Calls on the speakerphone, a headset or Bluetooth continue.
Closing the phone keeps the call going on the speakerphone

A call answered or started on the cover screen, or one that continues after the phone is folded past halfway, uses the speakerphone. Closing the phone never ends an emergency call; it moves it to the speakerphone.
